Name: Seasonal Anime portraits for - Dateable Robin for 1.6
Author: yhzx
Description:
I like the Anime Seasonal Portraits mod and Dateable Robin for 1.6, so I made this to make them compatible with each other.

[b]!! IMPORTANT: To use this mod, please use Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic V5.0.2 !![/b]

Although SCA 6.0.0 may have better performance, it changed the portrait replacement logic, which breaks support for many older mods such as ValleyGirl.
That’s why I chose SCA version 5.0.2—it has almost the same content as 6.0.0, but offers much better compatibility.

Mod enhanced: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35126?tab=description]Dateable Robin for 1.6[/url]
Style used: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/50885611]ohodavi[/url]
Seasonal Portraits: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]
Anime Seasonal: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22876]Anime Seasonal Outfits[/url]

Installation:
Extract and overwrite the original files in both Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic and Dateable Robin for 1.6.
Then remember to enable the sprites option (required to make this mod’s sprites show up).
